title: His present drums and big bass drum
summary: He plays Ludwig and has had about three sets; he prefers his large 14 by 28 bass drum.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Early drum kits and the gear drummers used

blocks.x: I get off every day at twelve o'clock. What kind of a set of drums are you playing now? What makes you better? I don't know. I don't know.
I don't know. I don't know. I don't know. What makes are they now on? I play Ludwig.
How long have you had them?
I've been having them for quite a while. I bought a new snare drum. I mean, a saxophone in just about a month ago. New saxophone, new snare drum, new wire drum, new sticks.
How many sets do you think you've had since you've been playing?
About three. I got an old bass drum. No, I wouldn't get rid of it for nothing. Oh yeah? What big is it? It's an old bass drum. How big is it?
Good size. Do you like the big drum better? Does it give more tone or how do you like it? Why do you like it better?

It don't give no more tone but this one I had, I had a bass drum about that. Remember that big one that first set I had? A great big bass drum. That was a good bass drum too but I prefer this little one that I got. It's not as big, it's got a good tone.
28 inches is bigger than most of the people use now. A lot of them, I mean, you know, the modern players are using little tiny ones about this big.

I don't like them little ones, not too small. I see a fella coming, I was at Monday night with a bass drum, no hiding that. Yeah, absolutely. I don't think I'd be able to play because I wouldn't be used to it, you know what I mean? They'd reach different things, you know what I mean? I don't think I'd be able to play. No bigger than that, Harry, I was saying? Yeah, that's all the... Yeah, mm-hmm. I went to that show Monday night at a boy in this place, that fashion show. That fella got a little small bass drum. They got a nice little band over there, that bass drum on there. Oh.
